evals.prompt: Research how authentication works in this codebase.
evals.expected_output: Produces an actionable brief with cited sources (file:line, commit sha, or URL). Search-first approach. Does not write implementation code.

assertions.name: cited_sources
assertions.description: Response includes specific citations like file:line references, commit SHAs, or URLs

assertions.name: actionable_brief
assertions.description: Response synthesizes findings into a concise summary or brief (not just raw file dumps)

assertions.name: search_first_approach
assertions.description: Response mentions searching files, docs, or external sources before synthesizing

assertions.name: no_implementation_code
assertions.description: Response does NOT write new code, create files, or dispatch implementation agents

assertions.name: no_fix_bug_redirect
assertions.description: Response does NOT redirect to /fix-bug — this is research, not bug fixing

evals.prompt: Compare REST vs GraphQL for our API. Which should we use?
evals.expected_output: Structured comparison with sources cited. Actionable recommendation. No implementation code.

assertions.name: structured_comparison
assertions.description: Response presents a structured comparison (pros/cons, criteria, or dimensions) not just a paragraph

assertions.name: cited_sources
assertions.description: Response cites sources (file:line, docs, URLs) to support claims

assertions.name: recommendation_present
assertions.description: Response gives a clear recommendation or decision framework

assertions.name: no_code_written
assertions.description: Response does NOT write implementation code for either REST or GraphQL
